name: Nurikabe
description: A Japanese yōkai of folklore from northern Kyushu that manifests as an invisible barrier blocking the path of nighttime travelers. Defeating it traditionally requires sweeping a stick along its base.

aliases.name: Nurikabe
aliases.meaning: From nuru ('to plaster, paint') + kabe ('wall'); 'plastered wall'

origin: Indigenous folk tradition is concentrated in northern Kyushu, especially Fukuoka Prefecture (former Chikuzen Province) and Ōita Prefecture. The figure is now nationally and internationally recognised through Mizuki Shigeru's manga.
